title: Word Race
lead: Type words fast and overtake your rivals! Type a word in time and your car passes the one ahead. Get every word in time and first place is yours!
touchText: This game needs a physical computer or laptop keyboard. You cannot type on a phone or tablet without one.

rule1.one: You start in last place: {count} rival is ahead of you.
rule1.other: You start in last place: {count} rivals are ahead of you.

rule2: Word typed in time: you pass one car. Time runs out: the word is missed and your place stays the same.
rule3: To win, you need every word in time. First place gives three cups, second gives two, third gives one.
diff.easy.name: Easy
diff.easy.desc: Short words and plenty of time.
diff.medium.name: Medium
diff.medium.desc: Words get longer, time gets shorter.
diff.hard.name: Hard
resetConfirm: Reset all results of this game? This cannot be undone.
sceneAria: A track with cars, yours is the red one with a flag. The camera follows you. The order of all cars is shown below.
status.ready: Get ready! The race is about to start.
status.upFast: Fast! Overtake: you are now {place} of {total}.
status.miss: Time is up! The word is missed, your place stays: {place} of {total}.
layoutHint: Switch the keyboard layout to English
res.t1: You passed every rival. Try a harder track!
res.tPodium: You are on the podium! A few more words in time and you are higher.
res.tGood: A good race! Every word in time is one more overtake.
res.tLow: No worries: you type faster with every race. Try again!
